tools.description: Check the authenticated gh CLI account and whether it has the 'project' scope required for all other tools in this server.
tools.name: gh_auth_status

tools.description: Close a repository issue with a completed or not-planned reason, then re-read and verify the final state. Requires confirm:true and refuses pull-request numbers.

confirm.description: Must be true to close the issue

tools.name: gh_issue_close

tools.description: Create an issue in a repo. Body is written via a temp file to avoid shell-escaping issues with newlines/quotes.

labels.description: Labels to apply (must already exist — use gh_label_ensure first)

tools.name: gh_issue_create

tools.description: Edit a repository issue and verify final state. Title/body/labels are non-destructive; closing through state=closed requires confirm:true. Pull-request numbers are refused.

labels.description: Labels to add without removing unrelated labels

tools.name: gh_issue_edit

tools.description: List issues in a repo, including each issue's GraphQL node id (needed by gh_subissue_link).
tools.name: gh_issue_list

tools.description: Create a label in a repo if it does not already exist (idempotent — safe to call every time before using a label).
tools.name: gh_label_ensure

tools.description: Open a pull request in a repo (wraps `gh pr create`). head is the branch to merge FROM; base (default "main") is the branch to merge INTO. Returns the created PR URL.
tools.name: gh_pr_create

tools.description: List pull requests in a repo (wraps `gh pr list`) with number, title, url, state, head/base branches, mergeability, and draft flag.
tools.name: gh_pr_list

tools.description: Merge a pull request (wraps `gh pr merge`). Destructive — requires confirm:true. Defaults to a squash merge and deletes the head branch afterwards.

confirm.description: Must be true to proceed — merging cannot be undone

deleteBranch.description: Delete the head branch after merge (default true)

tools.name: gh_pr_merge

tools.description: Copy a project to a new one (fields/views copied; items only with drafts:true).
tools.name: gh_project_copy

tools.description: Create a new GitHub Project (v2) board for a user or org.

owner.description: GitHub username or org login to own the project

tools.name: gh_project_create

tools.description: Permanently DELETE a project board and all its items. Irreversible — requires confirm:true.

confirm.description: Must be true to proceed — cannot be undone

tools.name: gh_project_delete

tools.description: Convert a draft-issue item into a real repository issue (convertProjectV2DraftIssueItemToIssue). The item keeps its board field values.

repo.description: Repo name (without owner) to create the issue in

repoOwner.description: Owner of the repo to create the issue in

tools.name: gh_project_draft_convert

tools.description: Edit a draft issue item's title and/or body (updateProjectV2DraftIssue). Accepts the project ITEM id (PVTI_…, from gh_project_item_create/list) and resolves the draft-content id (DI_…) that gh requires; a DI_ id is also accepted directly. For draft items only; use gh_project_item_edit for field values.

itemId.description: Draft item node ID (PVTI_…) or draft-content id (DI_…)

tools.name: gh_project_draft_edit

tools.description: Edit a project's metadata: title, description (shortDescription), README body, visibility, and open/closed state. Pass only the fields you want to change. Maps to `gh project edit` (title/description/readme/visibility) and `gh project close`/`--undo` (closed).

closed.description: true = close the project, false = reopen it

tools.name: gh_project_edit

tools.description: Create a custom Project field. TEXT/NUMBER/DATE/SINGLE_SELECT/MULTI_SELECT/ITERATION are supported through GraphQL; select fields require options and iteration fields require iterationConfiguration.

title.description: Iteration title; defaults to Iteration N

startDate.description: Start date of the first iteration, YYYY-MM-DD

options.description: Option labels — required for SINGLE_SELECT and MULTI_SELECT

tools.name: gh_project_field_create

tools.description: Permanently DELETE a custom field and its values on all items. Destructive — requires confirm:true. Built-in fields cannot be deleted.
tools.name: gh_project_field_delete

tools.description: List all fields on a project (built-in like Status/Assignees plus custom fields), with their IDs and option IDs for single-select fields. Always call this before gh_project_field_create or gh_project_item_edit to get current IDs — never hardcode them.
tools.name: gh_project_field_list

tools.description: Safely replace SINGLE_SELECT or MULTI_SELECT options while preserving existing option IDs. Pass the COMPLETE desired option set. Existing IDs are preserved by explicit id, unchanged name, or a single unambiguous rename; ambiguous renames fail closed. Removing options requires allowRemove:true and reports removed IDs/names.

allowRemove.description: Permit dropping existing options and their item assignments. Default false.

fieldId.description: SINGLE_SELECT or MULTI_SELECT field node ID

color.description: Omit to preserve existing color; new options default GRAY

description.description: Omit to preserve existing description; new options default empty

id.description: Existing option ID. Supply this for renamed options when more than one rename/addition is ambiguous.

tools.name: gh_project_field_option_update

tools.description: Add an existing issue or pull request to a project board by URL.

url.description: Full URL of the issue or PR to add

tools.name: gh_project_item_add

tools.description: Archive (or unarchive) an item on a project board without deleting the underlying issue/PR.
tools.name: gh_project_item_archive

tools.description: Create a draft-issue item directly on a project board (no repo issue). Draft issues live only on the board until converted with gh_project_draft_convert. Returns the created item (with its id).
tools.name: gh_project_item_create

tools.description: Remove an item from a project board permanently (distinct from archive). Does NOT delete the underlying issue/PR. Destructive — requires confirm:true.
tools.name: gh_project_item_delete

tools.description: Set or clear one Project item field value. MULTI_SELECT uses values[] of option IDs; other select/iteration values use value with the current option/iteration ID.

clear.description: Clear the field instead of setting a value

value.description: Value for text/number/date/single_select/iteration. Omit with clear=true.

values.description: MULTI_SELECT option IDs. Use clear=true to clear the field.

valueType.description: Which kind of value this field holds

tools.name: gh_project_item_edit

tools.description: List items (issues, PRs, draft issues) on a project board, with their current field values.
tools.name: gh_project_item_list

tools.description: Reorder an item on the board. Places it after afterItemId, or at the top if omitted (updateProjectV2ItemPosition).

afterItemId.description: Place the item after this item; omit to move to the top

tools.name: gh_project_item_move

tools.description: Configure an ITERATION field using GitHub's current schema. startDate/duration default from the first requested iteration for backwards compatibility; existing titles are preserved when omitted and the mutation is round-trip verified.

duration.description: Top-level cadence in days; defaults to iterations[0].duration

title.description: Preserve existing title for matching startDate when omitted

startDate.description: Top-level first iteration start date; defaults to iterations[0].startDate

tools.name: gh_project_iteration_configure

tools.description: Link a GitHub Project to a repository (or team), so items in that repo can be auto-added and the project shows up on the repo page.
tools.name: gh_project_link

tools.description: List GitHub Projects (v2) owned by a user or organization.

owner.description: GitHub username or org login, e.g. "thisis-romar"

tools.name: gh_project_list

tools.description: Mark (or, with undo:true, unmark) an ORG-owned project as a template. User-owned projects cannot be templates.
tools.name: gh_project_mark_template

tools.description: Unlink a project from a repository or team (mirror of gh_project_link).
tools.name: gh_project_unlink

tools.description: Get full details of one GitHub Project: title, description, visibility, item count, fields, and views (including view layout/createdAt, which the plain gh CLI does not surface).
tools.name: gh_project_view

tools.description: Declaratively create or reconcile Project views. Normal create/layout/filter/visible-field CRUD uses GitHub GraphQL. groupBy remains an explicit browser-ui fallback. Existing names are skipped unless reapply=true; pruneGhostViews deletes non-spec views (except the first/default view) and repairs layout mismatches.

pruneGhostViews.description: Destructive: delete non-spec views except the first/default view; also repair layout mismatches

reapply.description: Re-apply API-backed settings to matching existing views

groupBy.description: UI-only fallback: field name used for grouping, e.g. Status

visibleFieldIds.description: Ordered Project field node IDs to show in table/board layout

tools.name: gh_project_view_create

tools.description: Delete one Project view by name through deleteProjectV2View and verify it is absent. Destructive — requires confirm:true. No browser is used.
tools.name: gh_project_view_delete

tools.description: Edit one Project view by name. name/layout/filter/visibleFieldIds are GraphQL-backed. groupBy is the only browser-ui fallback.

filter.description: New filter; use empty string to clear

groupBy.description: UI-only fallback: Group by field name

visibleFieldIds.description: Ordered visible Project field node IDs

tools.name: gh_project_view_edit

tools.description: List a project's views with stable node IDs, layout, filter, ordered visible fields, and current group-by configuration.
tools.name: gh_project_views_list

tools.description: Configure GitHub Projects "Auto-add to project" through the browser-only Workflows UI. Omit filter to explicitly clear any existing filter and include every issue/PR. Requires local logged-in Edge/CDP and verifies both repository and filter after save.

filter.description: GitHub Projects filter syntax. Omit to clear any existing filter.

repo.description: Repository to auto-add from, as owner/repo

workflowName.description: Workflow card name; defaults to Auto-add to project

tools.name: gh_project_workflow_autoadd_configure

tools.description: Post a status update on a project (the "Add status update" feature on the project overview page). Requires project write scope.
tools.name: gh_status_update_create

tools.description: Delete a project status update. Destructive — requires confirm:true.
tools.name: gh_status_update_delete

tools.description: Edit an existing project status update (any of status/body/startDate/targetDate).
tools.name: gh_status_update_edit

tools.description: List a project's status updates (id, status, body, dates).
tools.name: gh_status_update_list

tools.description: Link an issue as a sub-issue of a parent (epic) issue. Both IDs must be GraphQL node IDs (not issue numbers) — get them from the `id` field returned by gh_issue_list.

childNodeId.description: Child issue GraphQL node ID to attach as a sub-issue

tools.name: gh_subissue_link

tools.description: Reorder a sub-issue within its parent (reprioritizeSubIssue). Places it after afterChildNodeId, or at the top if omitted.

afterChildNodeId.description: Place after this sub-issue; omit for top

tools.name: gh_subissue_reprioritize

tools.description: Remove a sub-issue link (removeSubIssue). Detaches the child; deletes neither issue.

childNodeId.description: Sub-issue GraphQL node ID to detach

tools.name: gh_subissue_unlink
